in_marathi.name: Janmajeya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born from an Egg
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janmajeya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words - 'Janma' meaning birth and 'Jaya' meaning victory. Janmajeya signifies one who is victorious at birth.
